verdict.rationale: Sentry Alerts explicitly support calling webhooks when issues/events match rules, which covers the core subscribe-to-events-via-webhook capability, but this is a general alerting feature rather than an AI-native subscription mechanism, and there's no dedicated webhook API docs or AI-specific webhook consumption pattern shown. missing for 10: dedicated webhook API/payload documentation, evidence of AI agents consuming these webhooks programmatically, and independent confirmation of reliability.
